name: Paulovs Shared Stash Trader
teaser: Adds a Trader that allows players to store and share items between profiles more easily
description_html:
Do you have multiple profiles and would like to share items between them?
Would you like some extra room to put random items?
Would you like to earn some easy money?

This is the mod for you!

This trader allows you to “sell” ANY item to it and it will store that item until you wish to buy it back. It will also allow you to easily store an item so that another profile can use it. This is great if you have several accounts and you’d like to provide a gigachad weapon to the level 1 account.

This mod was cut out of an external community mod that I made to be completely standalone. It does not require any other mods.

Much love to Chomp for his awesome work on SPT-Aki and his excellent Mod Examples.
